import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

 
data_sorted = data.sort_values('Grand Total', ascending=False)

 
top_10 = data_sorted.head(10)

 
ax = top_10.plot.bar(
    x='Student Name', 
    y='Grand Total', 
    title='Top 10 Students by Grand Total',
    figsize=(12, 6),
    color='skyblue'
)

 
for p in ax.patches:
    ax.annotate(
        f"{p.get_height():.1f}",  
        (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()), 
        ha='center', 
        va='center', 
        xytext=(0, 10), 
        textcoords='offset points'
    )

 
plt.xlabel('Student Name')
plt.ylabel('Grand Total Score')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)   
plt.tight_layout()   
plt.show()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

 
performance_counts = data['Performance Category'].value_counts()

 
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
colors = ['#ff9999','#66b3ff','#99ff99','#ffcc99']  
explode = (0.05, 0, 0, 0)  

performance_counts.plot(
    kind='pie',
    autopct='%1.1f%%',      
    startangle=90,           
    colors=colors,           
    explode=explode,         
    shadow=True,             
    wedgeprops={'edgecolor': 'black', 'linewidth': 1}  # Edge styling
)

 
plt.title('Student Performance Distribution', pad=20, fontweight='bold')
plt.ylabel('')  # Hide default y-axis label

 
plt.axis('equal')  

 
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

 
data.dropna(subset=['MEL Social (50 Est)', 'MEL Science (50 Est)', 'Grand Total'], inplace=True)

 
X = data[['MEL Social (50 Est)', 'MEL Science (50 Est)']]
y = data['Grand Total']

 
model = LinearRegression().fit(X, y)

 
data['Predicted Total'] = model.predict(X)

 
print("R² Score:", model.score(X, y))

    # FEL vs MEL distributions
    sns.histplot(data[f'FEL {subject} (50)'], kde=True, ax=axes[i,0], color='blue', label='FEL')
    sns.histplot(data[f'MEL {subject} (50 Est)'], kde=True, ax=axes[i,0], color='orange', label='MEL')
    axes[i,0].set_title(f'{subject} FEL vs MEL Distribution')
    axes[i,0].legend()
    sns.boxplot(data=data, y=f'Total {subject}', ax=axes[i,1], color='green')
    axes[i,1].set_title(f'Total {subject} Scores')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

from scipy import stats
print("\n=== MEL vs FEL Comparison ===")
mel_fel_comparison = pd.DataFrame()

for subject in subjects:
    fel_col = f'FEL {subject} (50)'
    mel_col = f'MEL {subject} (50 Est)'
    
    
    data[f'{subject} Diff'] = data[fel_col] - data[mel_col]
    
    
    corr, p_value = stats.pearsonr(data[fel_col], data[mel_col])
    print(f"{subject} FEL-MEL correlation: {corr:.2f} (p-value: {p_value:.4f})")
    
     
    mel_fel_comparison[f'{subject} FEL'] = data[fel_col]
    mel_fel_comparison[f'{subject} MEL'] = data[mel_col]

  
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.heatmap(mel_fel_comparison.corr(), annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', center=0)
plt.title('Correlation Matrix: FEL vs MEL Components')
plt.show()

 
print("\n=== Component Contribution ===")
for subject in subjects:
    data[f'{subject} FEL %'] = (data[f'FEL {subject} (50)'] / data[f'Total {subject}']) * 100
    data[f'{subject} MEL %'] = (data[f'MEL {subject} (50 Est)'] / data[f'Total {subject}']) * 100

contribution_stats = data[[f'{s} FEL %' for s in subjects] + [f'{s} MEL %' for s in subjects]].describe()
print(contribution_stats)

from sklearn.cluster import KMeans

 
cluster_data = data[[f'Total {s}' for s in subjects]].copy()
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
scaler = StandardScaler()
cluster_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(cluster_data)

 
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=42)
data['Cluster'] = kmeans.fit_predict(cluster_scaled)

 
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='Total English', y='Total Science', hue='Cluster', palette='viridis')
plt.title('Student Clusters Based on Subject Performance')
plt.show()

 
data.to_csv('analyzed_student_data.csv', index=False)
print("\nAnalysis complete. Enriched dataset saved.")

from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

 
cluster_data = data[[f'Total {s}' for s in subjects]].copy()
scaler = StandardScaler()
cluster_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(cluster_data)

 
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=42)
data['Cluster'] = kmeans.fit_predict(cluster_scaled)

 
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(
    data=data,
    x='Total English',
    y='Total Science',
    hue='Cluster',
    palette='viridis',
    s=100   
)

 
for i, row in data.iterrows():
    plt.text(
        row['Total English'] + 0.2,  
        row['Total Science'] + 0.2,
        row['Student Name'],    
        fontsize=8,
        color='black'
    )

plt.title('Student Clusters Based on Subject Performance (Labeled by Student)')
plt.xlabel('Total English Score')
plt.ylabel('Total Science Score')
plt.legend(title='Cluster')
plt.show()

 
data.to_csv('analyzed_student_data.csv', index=False)
print("\nAnalysis complete. Enriched dataset saved.")
